title: A whole home beyond endless assessment

captions.energy: Reassessing entire routines after every correction
captions.emotions: Feeling sufficiency and wholeness at home

meaning: Your domestic support feels more whole when a useful result can be recognised as sufficient without a compulsory reassessment of all shared life.
text: You may want to see that home is already arranged sufficiently for both. The Sun in the physical position of Muladhara appears through open actions and available benefit. Judgement in energy risks beginning general reassessment after every correction. The World in emotions wants wholeness and sufficiency. Completed work becomes hard to recognise as ready: both removed an inconvenience, but the result supposedly must also change their understanding of all shared life. Another review replaces use, always finding one more important open question.

For example, you make shoe storage more convenient. The hallway becomes freer, but conversation immediately concerns whether the entire home is organised correctly and each participates sufficiently. **A sufficient result need not finish a general reassessment of arrangements every time.** You can notice and use the open passage. A larger conversation retains room, but today’s benefit need not await a final answer about every household responsibility, habit and earlier decision.

The difficulty is considering recognition of readiness superficial and demanding depth again. Wholeness stays inaccessible because every result opens another assessment of the whole. Support grows when completion has a specific scale. Both can understand home gradually: a ready part already supports life, and open questions need not cancel everything received or turn convenience into a participation test.
